principle: TNF stores product metadata, indexes, lightweight generated artifacts, and storage references. TNF is not a member cloud drive.

productPrompts.oversizeUpload: This file is larger than TNF direct upload storage. Save it in Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, OneDrive, or customer object storage, then attach the link for indexing.
productPrompts.nearQuota: You are nearing the TNF hosted working-set limit. Move durable docs and media to connected storage and keep only links, extracts, and indexes in TNF.
productPrompts.quotaExceeded: TNF hosted storage is full for this plan. Delete temporary artifacts, export data, upgrade with a storage contract, or connect external storage.
